question: Nitroglycerin extended-release capsules are used to ease and avoid a certain _______ disease symptom.
solution:
The correct answer is __**heart**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **order to stop angina **(**chest pain**) brought **on by coronary artery disease**, **nitroglycerin is taken**.
 
• This **medication **is also used **to stop an angina attack **from **starting**.
 
• This medicine **is a member of the nitrate drug family**.
 
• When the **heart muscle is not receiving enough blood**, **angina develops**.
 
• **Blood arteries **are opened up and **relaxed by this medication**, allowing for **easier blood flow **to the heart.
 
• When **chest pain starts**, this drug **won't help**.
 
• Additionally, it is not meant to be used right before engaging in physical activity (like exercise or sexual activity) in order to prevent chest pain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cause of Chest Pain**:

 
 
• The most **common causes **of **pleuritic chest pain **are **bacterial or viral infections**, **pulmonary embolism, **and **pneumothorax**.
 
• Other less common causes include **rheumatoid arthritis, lupus, and cancer**.
 
• **Pneumonia or lung abscess**.
 
• These lung infections can cause **pleuritic and other types of chest pain, such as a deep chest ache**.
